title: vosu.client
description: Identifies the attached client of one session. Required: every published session carries a complete vosu.client namespace. Core fills `session`, `pid`, `focused` and `plugin` directly; the game plugin fills `game`, `variant`, `name` and `version` by sending `VOSU_OP_SESSION_IDENTIFY` (docs/v2/plugin-abi.md). Capability id: field:vosu.client(.<path>).

game.description: Game identifier, e.g. `osu`. Matches the `game:<game-id>` capability id this client satisfies.

variant.description: Client variant/fork, in the game's own terms, e.g. `stable` or `lazer`.

name.description: Display name for the client, suitable to show a user.

version.description: The client's own version string, in its own format. Not a semver guarantee.

pid.description: OS process id of the attached client.

session.description: Opaque session id, minted by core, stable for the attachment's lifetime.

focused.description: Whether this session is the one `/api/v1/sessions/active` currently addresses. Core recomputes this for every session on each focus change and sends `FOCUS_CHANGED` (plugin-abi.md) to the owning plugin; see docs/v2/state-schema.md#focus for the selection algorithm.

plugin.description: The game plugin instance that published this session.
